fomod.Name: Zone Bodycam
fomod.Author: Built for this GAMMA setup. Motion model after Sludge's Intrusive 3D Masks.
fomod.Description: Chest-mounted tactical bodycam: post-upscale optical fisheye lens, squircle housing and chest-rig occlusion, Axon CMOS sensor pipeline, damped body motion, line-of-sight ally markers, and a top-right overlay rendered inside postprocess above the vignette. Automatically scales across 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, and 32:9 displays with zero extra patches required. Everything is configurable in MCM. Optional: a battery-powered Body Camera item with hand animations. The lens needs modded exes 2026.10.11 or newer (Shader Bus); the Slop-Ray engine also works.
